messages.content: Follow the requested format exactly. Do not add an introduction.
In one concise sentence, explain why careful measurement is important when optimizing software.
Read the synthetic technical report and answer only the final question in no more than two sentences.

Synthetic technical report:

A research team operates a document-processing service on a single workstation. Incoming documents are converted to normalized text, divided into sections, and passed to a language model with a stable instruction prefix. The service records request identifiers and timing metadata but does not retain private document content. During the first week, the team notices that short requests feel responsive while requests containing long reports wait noticeably longer before any generated text appears. Once generation starts, however, tokens arrive at a fairly steady rate.

The team establishes a measurement procedure. The workstation remains connected to AC power, background applications are closed, and each configuration receives the same warmup sequence. Every measured request records client start time, first streamed content, completion time, input tokens, output tokens, model identity, and engine-reported durations. Cold model loading is measured separately from steady-state execution. Failed requests remain in the dataset instead of being silently discarded.

For the first experiment, the researchers keep the requested answer length fixed while increasing the prompt from a short note to a medium article and then to a long report. They predict that time to first token will rise because the model must process more input tokens before autoregressive generation begins. They also predict that output-token speed will remain comparatively stable because the generation length and runtime configuration are unchanged.

A second experiment keeps the prompt fixed while increasing the requested output length. The researchers expect total latency to grow with the number of generated tokens. They distinguish the initial prompt-processing phase from the repeated decode steps and avoid dividing total request latency by output tokens when reporting time per output token. They store raw request records so every aggregate can be recomputed.

A final experiment will eventually introduce multiple simultaneous clients. That experiment is intentionally delayed until single-request timing is verified. The team wants to ensure that HTTP streaming, timestamp boundaries, token counts, and failure handling are correct before interpreting batching or queueing behavior.

Question: Which phase of model execution is the most likely reason that longer reports increase the wait before the first generated token?
Produce the requested numbered list without an introduction or conclusion.

Write twelve numbered, one-sentence observations about designing reproducible performance experiments for an LLM inference server. Each observation must describe a different experimental control or measurement consideration.
